backend/main.mo: Main actor for the ICP backend defining user profiles, posts, comments, and free stuff posts with CRUD operations, access control, and blob storage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades existing `FreeStuffPost` records by adding the `isAvailable` field defaulting to `true`.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping four frontend feature IDs (availability badge, filter toggle, creation form toggle, hooks) to their target files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated summary document listing short descriptions of all frontend source files including components, hooks, and config files.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file setting up Tailwind base layers and OKLCH CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point titled 'RoFree Hub - Roblox Fan Community' with Nunito font, favicon, and the React app root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component handling Internet Identity authentication, profile setup modal display, and routing between the login screen and the main feed page.
frontend/src/components/CommentForm.tsx: Form component for submitting a new comment on a post, using the `useAddComment` mutation hook with loading state.
frontend/src/components/CommentItem.tsx: Displays a single comment with a blocky avatar, author username fetched by profile hook, relative timestamp, and Roblox-themed styling.
frontend/src/components/CommentList.tsx: Fetches and renders a list of comments for a given post using the useGetComments hook, showing a spinner while loading and an empty-state message if no comments exist.
frontend/src/components/FreeStuffCreatio: A form component for creating free stuff posts with fields for title, description, category, content type, tags, link, proof, and availability, submitting via the useCreateFreeStuffPost hook.
frontend/src/components/FreeStuffFeed.ts: Displays a filterable, sortable feed of free stuff posts with category filter buttons, an available-only toggle, and newest/top-liked sort options, rendering FreeStuffPostCard components.
frontend/src/components/FreeStuffPostCar: Renders a card for a single free stuff post showing author avatar, category badge, availability/expiration status, like button, and a reveal-on-click content section.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky top navigation header displaying the RoFree Hub logo/branding and a logout button that calls the provided onLogout callback.
frontend/src/components/LikeButton.tsx: A button component that displays the current like count for a post and triggers the useLikePost mutation when clicked.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Renders a community post card with author avatar, timestamp, content, a like button, and a toggleable comments section containing CommentForm and CommentList.
frontend/src/components/PostCreationForm: A simple textarea form for creating community posts, submitting content via the useCreatePost hook with a loading state indicator.
frontend/src/components/PostFeed.tsx: Fetches all posts via useGetAllPosts and renders them as a list of PostCard components, with loading and empty-state handling.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog component that collects a username and bio to create a new user profile, using the useSaveCallerUserProfile hook to persist the data.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddComment.ts: A mutation hook that calls the backend addComment method for a given post and invalidates the relevant comments query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateFreeStuffPos: A mutation hook that submits a new free-stuff post to the backend with all required fields and invalidates the freeStuffPosts query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreatePost.ts: A mutation hook that creates a general post via the backend actor and invalidates the allPosts query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllPosts.ts: A query hook that fetches all posts from the backend actor, enabled only when the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: A query hook that fetches the currently authenticated user's profile from the backend, exposing combined loading state from both the actor and the query.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetComments.ts: A query hook that fetches comments for a specific post ID from the backend actor.
A query hook that fetches free-stuff posts from the backend, supporting optional filtering by category, tag, and sort order.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetLikeCount.ts: A query hook that retrieves the like count for a specific post ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserProfile.ts: A query hook that fetches a user profile by user ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook that manage Internet Computer authentication via AuthClient, exposing identity, login, clear, and status state.
A mutation hook that likes a free-stuff post by ID and invalidates the freeStuffPosts query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useLikePost.ts: A mutation hook that likes a general post and invalidates both the likeCount and allPosts queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: A mutation hook that creates or updates the caller's user profile via the backend and invalidates the currentUserProfile query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateFreeStuffAva: A mutation hook that updates the availability status of a free-stuff post and invalidates the freeStuffPosts query on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that configures Tailwind, defines CSS custom properties for a Roblox-inspired red/white/gold color palette in light and dark modes, and adds utility classes for game-themed UI elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Main feed page component with two tabs ('Free Stuff' and 'Community') that renders creation forms and feed lists for free stuff posts and community posts, gating creation behind Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, using sessionStorage for cross-navigation persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a Roblox-themed design system with custom colors (roblox-red, roblox-gold, roblox-gray), game-style border radii, box shadows, and typography/animation plugins.
project_state.json: Project state manifest tracking existing implemented features and pending feature requests for a Roblox fan app, including an `isAvailable` field for free stuff posts and related UI/hook updates.
